name: Terenas Menethil II
summary: Across Lordaeron, Terenas Menethil II bears the burden of war and its aftermath. For more than five decades, he ruled as a wise and diplomatic king, forged the Alliance of Lordaeron during the Second War, and sheltered the young Prince Varian Wrynn. His corrupted son, Prince Arthas, murdered him, and Lordaeron began to fall to the Scourge.

sections.title: Architect of the Alliance
sections.body: When Stormwind refugees reached the north with Sir Anduin Lothar, King Terenas Menethil II answered their call. He gathered the monarchs of the divided human kingdoms and envoys from Ironforge and Quel'Thalas. Together, they formed the Alliance of Lordaeron. Terenas gave command of its armies to Lothar, its supreme commander, rather than claiming it for himself. For the first time in millennia, humanity’s kingdoms stood united. Together, they defeated the Old Horde.

sections.title: The Strains of Victory
sections.body: After the Second War, Terenas insisted that surviving orcs be held in internment camps rather than executed. He believed peace might endure once their demonic fury had faded. Yet the camps placed a heavy tax burden on Lordaeron’s allies. Gilneas shut itself behind the Greymane Wall, Stromgarde left the Alliance over political disputes, and the high elves withdrew entirely. As the coalition fractured, Terenas bore its cost.

sections.title: The Fall of the Throne
sections.body:
Terenas faced orc revolts led by Thrall, whispers of death cults in the north, and a mysterious plague. A wandering prophet urged him to abandon Lordaeron and flee across the sea to Kalimdor. Terenas dismissed the prophet as mad.

Soon after, Prince Arthas returned from his northern campaign, hailed as a victor. During the royal celebrations, Arthas knelt before his father, drew the runeblade Frostmourne, and drove it through Terenas’s heart. The kingdom was shattered.

faq.q: Who was King Terenas Menethil II?
faq.answer: King Terenas Menethil II ruled Lordaeron for more than fifty years and shaped northern politics. During the Second War, he founded the Alliance of Lordaeron to fight the Horde. He governed from Capital City until his murder.

Terenas died at the hand of his son, Prince Arthas Menethil, in the throne room. Corrupted by the runeblade Frostmourne during his expedition to Northrend, Arthas returned to Capital City hailed as a victor. He drove the blade through his father’s heart.

faq.q: What was Terenas's relationship with Stormwind?
faq.answer: Terenas helped Stormwind survive. After the southern kingdom fell in the First War, he gave its survivors haven and raised Prince Varian Wrynn alongside his own son Arthas. He treated Varian like a second son until Stormwind could be reclaimed and rebuilt.

faq.q: Why did the Alliance of Lordaeron break apart under his rule?
faq.answer: After the Second War, Terenas chose to hold captured orcs in internment camps rather than execute them. Their great cost stirred anger among the member realms. Gilneas built the Greymane Wall and isolated itself, Stromgarde left over policy disputes, and the elves of Quel'Thalas withdrew entirely.

faq.q: Did Terenas know about the Plague of Undeath?
faq.answer: Terenas knew of strange cults and a spreading sickness in the north, but underestimated the danger. Dalaran urged him to quarantine northern towns, yet he hesitated, fearing more suffering for his people. He sent Prince Arthas and Uther the Lightbringer to investigate, unaware of the trap awaiting them.

faq.q: Why didn't Terenas listen to the mysterious Prophet?
faq.answer: A cloaked prophet came to Terenas’s council chamber and urged him to evacuate Lordaeron’s people west to Kalimdor. Terenas dismissed him as an unhinged zealot. He believed his armies, paladins, and sturdy kingdom could endure the coming trials.

angles.text: As a human, you remember King Terenas as a legendary patriarch who united the seven kingdoms against impossible odds. His sudden betrayal and death at his own son’s hands remain a national tragedy.
As an Alliance member, you inherit the coalition Terenas forged with Anduin Lothar to defeat the Old Horde in the Second War.

As a paladin, you follow a path Terenas helped shape with Archbishop Alonsus Faol and Uther the Lightbringer. Together, they fostered the Knights of the Silver Hand. Terenas guided his own son into the order.
As Forsaken, you once called Capital City home under Terenas, your last living sovereign. His fall doomed the realm to the Scourge.
